wikitext.*: {{Short description|none}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2022–23 |team=Texas A&M Aggies |sport=Basketball |image=Texas A&M University logo.svg |image_size=125 |conference=Southeastern Conference |short_conf=SEC |record=25–10 |conf_record=15–3 |CoachRank=25 |APRank=17 |head_coach=[[Buzz Williams]] |hc_year=4th |assoc_coach=Devin Johnson | asst_coach1=[[Steve Roccaforte]] | asst_coach2=Lyle Wolf |stadium=[[Reed Arena]] |tourney=[[2023 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result=First Round }} {{2022–23 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas A&M University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team were led by fourth-year head coach [[Buzz Williams]] and played their home games at [[Reed Arena]] in [[College Station, Texas]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 25-10, 15–3 in SEC play to finish in second place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2023 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] and [[2022–23 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] to advance to the championship game, where they lost to [[2022–23 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]]. The Aggies received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] as a No. 7 seed, where they were defeated in the first round by [[2022–23 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Aggies]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 27–13, 9–9 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a five-way tie for fifth place. As the No. 8 seed in the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]], [[2021–22 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]], and [[2021–22 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] to advance to the championship game, where they lost to [[2021–22 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as a No. 1 seed. They defeated [[2021–22 Alcorn State Braves basketball team|Alcorn State]], [[2021–22 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]], [[2021–22 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]], and [[2021–22 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] to advance to the NIT championship game. There, they lost to [[2021–22 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" ! Name !! Number !! Pos. !! Height !! Weight !!
